facts.fact: SoleCrypt announced a planned 40 MW AI campus in Bizerte, with a 7 MW first phase of 1,728 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, targeted to come online in early 2028.

TUN.note: Campus and the 60 MW Tozeur solar and battery project are planned, not in service.
The campus is planned for 2028; no data centre in service is stated.
Only says the planned campus is 3.6 km from the Medusa landing; no route in service is stated.
No nationally owned data centre in service is stated.
No startup law, label or fund is stated.
No hub, incubator or park is stated.
